as_told.title: Parsons believed he was guided by a non-human intelligence

plain: Jack Parsons, whom the researcher Diana Pasulka calls "the father of our space program," is said to have believed he was in contact with beings from beyond Earth. Pasulka tells Michels this on two shows. She says Parsons worked with the occultist Aleister Crowley, and that "the Parsons crew" did ritual magic in the desert near Los Angeles and believed "they were in contact with extraterrestrials." On a later show, Michels tells it himself and places it in Pasadena from 1946 on. He says "Parsons himself believed he had made contact" and was "guided by a non-human intelligence," and he credits Pasulka and a book called Bedeviled. If true, one of the founders of American rocketry would have seen his work as guided from outside humanity.
